Collection process

Four steps from stored oil to documented pickup.

Used oil condition and contamination affect recovery and commercial value, so every enquiry starts with the essentials.

Tell us the volume

Share oil type, approximate quantity, storage method and pickup location.

Test a sample

Density, viscosity, water, sediment and other relevant properties are reviewed.

Plan collection

Pickup date, vehicle, containers and site coordination are confirmed.

Document the movement

The applicable collection and transport records are provided for the transaction.
